summary: Three added ArrayBuffer Scaladoc entries misstate or omit observable behavior; AnyRefMap checks were otherwise sound.

items.issue: The comment says this is the capacity that `clearAndShrink` shrinks to. `clearAndShrink()` calls `resize(16)`, which only shrinks: a buffer whose backing array is already smaller than 16 retains its smaller capacity.
items.suggestion: Describe it as the default target passed to `clearAndShrink`, and note that `clearAndShrink` does not grow a smaller backing array.

items.issue: The added contract omits that `size` and `step` must both be positive. The delegated `IndexedSeqOps.sliding` immediately throws `IllegalArgumentException` when either is less than 1.
items.suggestion: Add `@throws IllegalArgumentException if `size` or `step` is less than 1`.

items.issue: The class and iterator-family documentation present all instances as mutation-checked/fail-fast, but the public deprecated `(array, length)` constructor installs a constant mutation count. Its own added documentation says its iterators never detect concurrent mutation.
items.suggestion: Qualify the fail-fast and mutation-checked claims as applying to views returned by `ArrayBuffer#view`, or explicitly preserve the legacy constructor exception in the class and affected method documentation.
